sentences.en: The finale was so good, that I rewatched it many times.
sentences.zh: 这部终曲真是太精彩了，我看了好几遍。

sentences.en: The series finale was good, but the show itself was phenomenal.
sentences.zh: 系列的终场不错，但整部剧更棒。

sentences.en: I wanna be at home at four o'clock for the series finale.
sentences.zh: 我想四点钟的时候在家看系列的终场。

senses.zh: 最后，最终；乐曲的最后部分
